close_reason: Two-pass update loop: vacating updates run first, roles_actually_vacated populated only on success; failed vacate no longer releases role to same-request claim
description: handle_mailbox_set pre-scans all updates for role:null patches to build roles_vacated_this_request BEFORE running the update loop. When update B claims a role, it skips the taken-check because the role appears in roles_vacated_this_request. But if the update A that was supposed to vacate the role fails (backend Other error, concurrent conflict, etc.), the original mailbox still holds the role. Result: two mailboxes with the same role in one account. Trigger: request with update[A]={role:null} that fails, update[B]={role:<same role>} that succeeds. Fix: either post-scan after successful updates, or check at claim time rather than pre-scan.
title: Mailbox/set: role-uniqueness broken if vacate update fails
